title: Copay Offset in Coinsurance Review by Insured Plan of Care Payer Program
content:
On an Insured Plan of Care payer program that collects the copay at the time of service, the copay charge posted for the reviewed visit is taken out before the coinsurance percentage is applied, and where no copay charge was posted for that visit the copay on file is taken out instead; on a payer program that does not collect the copay at the time of service, nothing is taken out for the copay.

The amount taken out is subtracted, together with any other amount taken out before the coinsurance percentage is applied, from the amount the percentage is applied to; the remainder is never taken below zero, and the percentage then acts once on that remainder.

| Payer program | Copay collected at the time of service | Copay taken out in coinsurance review |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | Yes | The copay charge posted for the visit, or the copay on file where none was posted |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | No | Nothing |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | Yes | The copay charge posted for the visit, or the copay on file where none was posted |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | Yes | The copay charge posted for the visit, or the copay on file where none was posted |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | No | Nothing |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | Yes | The copay charge posted for the visit, or the copay on file where none was posted |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | No | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- *Commercial PPO, copay charge of $30.00 posted for the reviewed visit, copay on file now $35.00:* $30.00 is taken out — the charge actually posted for the visit.
- *Commercial HMO, no copay charge posted for the reviewed visit, copay on file $25.00:* $25.00 is taken out.
- *Medicare Part B, copay on file $20.00:* nothing is taken out, because the program does not collect the copay at the time of service.
